mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.original_material_id AS originalMaterialId, s.substitute_material_id AS substituteMaterialId, m1.material_name AS originalName, m2.material_name AS substituteName, s.original_qty AS originalQty, s.substitute_qty AS substituteQty, s.sub_type AS subType, CASE s.sub_type WHEN 1 THEN '完全替代' WHEN 2 THEN '临时替代' ELSE '其他' END AS subTypeName, s.remark, s.is_valid AS isValid, CASE WHEN s.original_material_id = #{materialId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isOriginalQuery, (s.substitute_qty / s.original_qty) AS nRatio, 1 / (s.substitute_qty / s.original_qty) AS invNRatio FROM `bom_material_substitute` s LEFT JOIN `清洗_物料主数据` m1 ON m1.material_id = s.original_material_id LEFT JOIN `清洗_物料主数据` m2 ON m2.material_id = s.substitute_material_id WHERE s.is_valid = 1 AND ( s.original_material_id = #{materialId} OR s.substitute_material_id = #{materialId} ) ORDER BY s.create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `bom_material_substitute` WHERE is_valid = 1 AND ( (original_material_id = #{materialId1} AND substitute_material_id = #{materialId2}) OR (original_material_id = #{materialId2} AND substitute_material_id = #{materialId1}) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `bom_material_substitute` (original_material_id, substitute_material_id, original_qty, substitute_qty, sub_type, remark, is_valid) VALUES (#{originalMaterialId}, #{substituteMaterialId}, #{originalQty}, #{substituteQty}, #{subType}, #{remark}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE `bom_material_substitute` SET original_qty = #{originalQty}, substitute_qty = #{substituteQty}, sub_type = #{subType}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_valid = 1
mapper.select:
SELECT s.id, s.original_material_id AS originalMaterialId, s.substitute_material_id AS substituteMaterialId, m1.material_name AS originalName, m2.material_name AS substituteName, s.original_qty AS originalQty, s.substitute_qty AS substituteQty, s.sub_type AS subType, CASE s.sub_type WHEN 1 THEN '完全替代' WHEN 2 THEN '临时替代' ELSE '其他' END AS subTypeName, s.remark, s.is_valid AS isValid, s.create_time AS createTime FROM `bom_material_substitute` s LEFT JOIN `清洗_物料主数据` m1 ON m1.material_id = s.original_material_id LEFT JOIN `清洗_物料主数据` m2 ON m2.material_id = s.substitute_material_id WHERE s.is_valid = 1
AND ( s.original_material_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.substitute_material_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY s.create_time DESC
